'''"See You on the Dark Side" ''' was a popular [[Music/Legends|song]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era.

[[Koth Vortena]] put thing song on speakers, when he and his companions were fixing the [[Gravestone]], after centuries it has been lying in the [[Endless Swamp]] on [[Zakuul]].

==Behind the scenes==
"See You on the Dark Side" is background music heard in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Players can select it in [[Jukebox/Legends|jukeboxes]] using a jukebox token.

==Appearances==
* ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
* ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''
